name: Tower of Zombies 🧟
desc:
Battle endless waves of zombies as you climb the tower to face 5 powerful bosses!

⚔️ Every tower is randomly generated so no two runs are the same!
🔫 Buy and upgrade weapons, unlock camos, and customize attachments!
🔥 Test your skills in Hard and Extreme modes for the ultimate challenge!

Please report any issues or bugs on our group forums. Thanks 😁
